No import-time allocation, process, Game, SCREEN or CAS actions.

class FilePin(TypedDict):
    path: str
    bytes: int
    sha256: str

@dataclass
class Held:
    label: str
    argv: list[str]
    process: subprocess.Popen[bytes]
    stdout: BinaryIO
    stderr: BinaryIO
    began: float
    birth_filetime: str
    waited: bool=False
    code: int | None=None
    wait_receipt_attempted: bool=False
    wait_receipt_written: bool=False

# Only original Popen objects enter this registry. The entry-point finally keeps
# them alive even if a receipt, cleanup operation, or interrupt itself fails.
ORIGINAL_HANDLES: list[Held]=[]
NORMAL_FACTS_READER: Callable[[], dict[str,object] | None] | None=None

def now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)

def require(ok: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not ok:
        raise RuntimeError(message)

def obj(value: object) -> dict[str, object]:
    if not isinstance(value,dict) or any(not isinstance(k,str) for k in value):
        raise TypeError("JSON object with text keys required")
    return value

def read(path: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    return obj(json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")))

def pin(path: Path) -> FilePin:
    path=path.resolve(strict=True)
    require(path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink() and not path.is_junction(),"Ordinary pinned input")
    before=path.stat()
    data=path.read_bytes()
    after=path.stat()
    require(before.st_size==after.st_size==len(data) and before.st_mtime_ns==after.st_mtime_ns,
            "Input changed while reading")
    return {"path":str(path),"bytes":len(data),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}

def checked(path: Path, expected: str, size: int | None=None) -> FilePin:
    value=pin(path)
    require(value["sha256"]==expected and (size is None or value["bytes"]==size),"Exact input Pin: "+str(path))
    return value

def ref(value: object) -> FilePin:
    row=obj(value)
    require(set(row)=={"path","bytes","sha256"},"Exact FilePin fields")
    path,size,sha=row["path"],row["bytes"],row["sha256"]
    require(isinstance(path,str) and type(size) is int and isinstance(sha,str),"FilePin types")
    if not isinstance(path,str) or type(size) is not int or not isinstance(sha,str):
        raise TypeError("FilePin types")
    return checked(Path(path),sha,size)

def put(name: str, value: dict[str, object]) -> None:
    document={"machine_id":MACHINE,"observed_at_utc":now().isoformat(),**value}
    with (E/(name+".actual.json")).open("x",encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(document,stream,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")

def creation(process: subprocess.Popen[bytes]) -> str:
    class FT(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_=[("low",ctypes.c_uint32),("high",ctypes.c_uint32)]
    k=ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32",use_last_error=True)
    k.GetProcessTimes.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,*([ctypes.POINTER(FT)]*4)]
    k.GetProcessTimes.restype=ctypes.c_int
    a,b,c,d=FT(),FT(),FT(),FT()
    # Original Popen handle, including a fast exited child; no PID reopen/reuse.
    if not k.GetProcessTimes(int(process._handle),ctypes.byref(a),ctypes.byref(b),ctypes.byref(c),ctypes.byref(d)):
        raise ctypes.WinError(ctypes.get_last_error())
    return str((a.high<<32)|a.low)

def creation_seconds(filetime: str) -> str:
    seconds,fraction=divmod(int(filetime)-116444736000000000,10000000)
    return (str(seconds)+"."+str(fraction).zfill(7)).rstrip("0").rstrip(".")

def consume_original(item: Held) -> int:
    if not item.waited:
        item.code=item.process.wait()
        item.waited=True
    if item.code is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Consumed wait missing actual code")
    item.stdout.close();item.stderr.close()
    if not item.wait_receipt_attempted:
        item.wait_receipt_attempted=True
        put(item.label+".original-wait",{"pid":item.process.pid,
            "process_creation_filetime_100ns":item.birth_filetime,
            "original_wait_returncode":item.code,"elapsed_seconds":time.monotonic()-item.began,
            "finished_at_utc":now().isoformat()})
        item.wait_receipt_written=True
    return item.code

def drain_original_handles() -> None:
    if not ORIGINAL_HANDLES:
        return
    actual_public=any(item.label=="PUBLIC-RUN" for item in ORIGINAL_HANDLES)
    if actual_public:
        # Never turn a failure/interrupt into public or Game termination. If the
        # normal closure reader itself failed, Root must close the real session.
        last=0.0
        while True:
            try:
                if NORMAL_FACTS_READER is not None and NORMAL_FACTS_READER() is not None:
                    break
                if time.monotonic()-last>=60:
                    print("FINAL_SAFETY_HOLD_PUBLIC_ORIGINALS_ROOT_ACTUAL_LIFECYCLE_REQUIRED",flush=True)
                    last=time.monotonic()
                time.sleep(.25)
            except BaseException:
                traceback.print_exc()
    for item in ORIGINAL_HANDLES:
        while not item.waited:
            try:
                print("FINAL_SAFETY_RETAIN_ORIGINAL_WAIT "+item.label+" PID="+str(item.process.pid),flush=True)
                consume_original(item)
            except BaseException:
                traceback.print_exc()
                # Only the original handle is waited. No STOP, kill, replay,
                # resource release or guessed return code occurs in this drain.
                if not item.waited:
                    try:
                        time.sleep(.25)
                    except BaseException:
                        traceback.print_exc()
        try:
            consume_original(item)
        except BaseException:
            traceback.print_exc()
        print("ORIGINAL_WAIT_ACTUAL "+json.dumps({"label":item.label,"pid":item.process.pid,
            "process_creation_filetime_100ns":item.birth_filetime,"returncode":item.code,
            "receipt_written":item.wait_receipt_written},sort_keys=True),flush=True)



def capacity_gate(path: Path, stage: str, grant_ref: FilePin, grant: dict[str, object],
                  source_commit: str, minimum: int, expected_sha: str | None = None,
                  context: Path | None = None, allocation_stdout: Path | None = None,
                  run_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, object]:
    actual = pin(path)
    if expected_sha is not None:
        require(actual["sha256"] == expected_sha, "Actual Root capacity gate Pin")
    gate = read(path)
    observed = datetime.fromisoformat(str(gate["observed_at_utc"]).replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    current = now()
    require(gate.get("schema") == "rrf-root-scene-capacity-gate-v1" and gate.get("stage") == stage
            and gate.get("machine_id") == MACHINE and gate.get("source_commit") == source_commit
            and Path(str(gate["approved_root"])).resolve() == C
            and 0 <= (current-observed).total_seconds() <= 180, "Fresh exact Root capacity gate")
    require(ref(gate["grant"]) == grant_ref, "Gate binds unchanged actual G")
    head_ref = ref(gate["storage_head"])
    head = read(Path(head_ref["path"]))
    require(Path(head_ref["path"]).resolve() == REPO.parent/".codex-task-bus/storage/volume-C-current.json"
            and head.get("machine_id") == MACHINE and head.get("source_commit") == source_commit
            and head.get("source_pending_fix") is False
            and head.get("new_scope_producer_grant") == grant_ref, "Current actual storage head binds G/source")
    ref(gate["capacity_evidence"])
    checks = obj(gate["checks"])
    required = {"physical", "owned", "gross", "quota", "component_caps", "metadata_subcaps",
                "system_paging", "writers_closed", "future_bounds", "deadline"}
    require(required <= set(checks) and all(v is True for v in checks.values()), "Every actual capacity check true")
    expiry = datetime.fromisoformat(str(grant["expires_at_utc"]).replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    latest = datetime.fromisoformat(str(gate["effective_latest_launch_utc"]).replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    require((expiry-current).total_seconds() >= minimum and current < latest
            and (expiry-latest).total_seconds() >= 6720, "Actual finite capacity/deadline reserve")
    if stage == "prelaunch":
        require(context is not None and allocation_stdout is not None and gate.get("run_id") == run_id,
                "Postallocate capacity binds actual run")
        require(ref(gate["ready_context"]) == pin(context)
                and ref(gate["allocation_stdout"]) == pin(allocation_stdout), "Actual READY/allocation capacity binding")
    require(pin(path) == actual and pin(Path(head_ref["path"])) == head_ref, "Gate/head stable while consumed")
    return {"receipt": actual, "gate": gate}

    parser.add_argument("--latest-screen-release-sha256")

    require(args.source_commit == "c2245a5a756745f14f0ba1769ce31ee05cdcbdcc", "Exact c224 source commit for this independent candidate")
    checked(SOURCE_ORIGINAL, "96b6c13374b0aa2056949e01430cb71620b3bd994c2136d0a8b84ddb0a524cb0", 36308)
    checked(SOURCE_A64, "22e23d4c4daa8d87c317e3abdede584c8f3ca175373b14d589cc1f3b65263035", 36319)

    ready_ref = checked(args.ready, args.ready_sha256)

            and grant.get("machine_id") == ready.get("machine_id") == MACHINE
            and grant.get("source_commit") == ready.get("source_commit") == args.source_commit,
            "Actual independent generic scene G and READY source/machine")
    require(Path(str(grant["approved_root"])).resolve() == C, "Only independently admitted C18 root")
    state = Path(str(grant["state_dir"])).resolve()
    require(state == C/"managed-states/review-zh-creation-blocker499-b01/state", "Exact independently prepared C18 UI state")
    expiry = datetime.fromisoformat(str(grant["expires_at_utc"]).replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    observed = datetime.fromisoformat(str(grant["observed_at_utc"]).replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    require(observed <= now() < expiry and expiry == datetime(2026,10,29,18,20,0,tzinfo=timezone.utc), "New independent finite1820Z admission; no old-G extension")
    require(type(grant["minimum_remaining_before_READY_pipeline_seconds"]) is int
            and grant["minimum_remaining_before_READY_pipeline_seconds"] == 6900
            and type(grant["minimum_remaining_before_actual_new_launch_seconds"]) is int
            and grant["minimum_remaining_before_actual_new_launch_seconds"] == 6720, "Root fixed READY/launch reserves")
    caps = obj(grant["scene_component_caps_bytes"])
    expected_caps = {
        "native_five_profile_save_slots_plus_one_atomic_or_postclose_export":456*1024**2,
        "cold_saved_campaign_real_input":72*1024**2,
        "cold_graphics_cache":320*1024**2,
        "wire_native_reports":96*1024**2,
        "screenshots_PNG":32*1024**2,
        "metadata_fixtures_logs_and_normal_close":176*1024**2}
    require(set(caps) == set(expected_caps) and all(type(caps[k]) is int and caps[k] == v for k,v in expected_caps.items())
            and sum(caps.values()) == 1152*1024**2,
            "Actual complete C18 1152MiB scene component cap including retained cold output")
    require(grant["metadata_subcaps_bytes"] == {"public_preparation":40*1024**2,"keeper":104*1024**2,"normal_close":32*1024**2},
            "Actual40/104/32MiB metadata partition")
    slots = obj(grant["native_slot_model"])
    expected_slots = {"new_final_game_save_slots":1,"SDK_episode_seed_slots":1,"new_atomic_slots":1,
                      "slot_bytes":128*1024**2,"canonical_export_slots":0,"real_input_separate":True}
    require(set(slots) == set(expected_slots) and all(type(slots[k]) is type(v) and slots[k] == v for k,v in expected_slots.items()),

    runtime, products, prepared = ref(ready["runtime"]), ref(ready["products"]), ref(ready["prepared_case"])

    require(Path(prepared["path"]).resolve() == C/"metadata/runtime-preparation-b01/prepared-ui-b01/prepared-case.json"
            and prepared["bytes"] == 54385 and prepared["sha256"] == "78142c59548e8016ab7072d0d01a9f44d22f300b46b804f36643a883621a98c9",

    actual_prepared = read(Path(prepared["path"]))

    startup = obj(actual_prepared["startup"])
    require(startup.get("mode") == "fixture" and "saved_campaign" not in startup
            and Path(str(startup["state_dir"])).resolve() == state, "Fresh UI fixture startup; no cold saved input")
    budgets = obj(actual_prepared["effective_budgets"])
    for key, value in {"readiness_timeout":1800,"timeout":3600,"hold_seconds":1800}.items():

    prior_ref = checked(args.previous_session_closure, args.previous_session_closure_sha256)

    previous = read(args.previous_session_closure)
    require(previous.get("machine_id") == MACHINE and previous.get("run_id") == MACHINE+"--religious-ritual-fusion--R0055"
            and previous.get("normal_close_qualified") is True and previous.get("business_pass") is False
            and previous.get("public_returncode") == 2 and previous.get("verify_returncode") == 2
            and previous.get("actual_host_returncode") == 0 and previous.get("allocator_returncode") == 0,
            "Actual R55/a65 normal resource closure; original public2 verify2 businessfalse retained")
    previous_sequence = grant.get("previous_SCREEN_release_sequence")
    require(type(previous_sequence) is int and previous_sequence > 0
            and args.previous_release_sequence == previous_sequence

            and type(task.get("last_sequence")) is int and type(event.get("sequence")) is int
            and task["last_sequence"] == event["sequence"] == previous_sequence and task.get("resources") == []
            and task.get("state") == "done", "Actual released predecessor resource state")
    latest_release = None
    if args.latest_screen_release is not None:
        require(args.latest_screen_release_sha256 is not None, "Actual separate latest SCREEN Pin")
        latest_release = checked(args.latest_screen_release,args.latest_screen_release_sha256)
        require(latest_release != release_ref, "Do not provide predecessor epoch twice")
    else:
        require(args.latest_screen_release_sha256 is None, "No orphan latest SCREEN digest")
    require(subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],cwd=REPO,text=True).strip() == args.source_commit,
            "Actual clean Root source commit")
    require(not subprocess.check_output(["git","status","--porcelain"],cwd=REPO), "Clean source required")
    pre = capacity_gate(args.preallocate_capacity,"preallocate",grant_ref,grant,args.source_commit,6900,args.preallocate_capacity_sha256)
    require(args.preallocate_capacity.resolve() == PRELAUNCH/"PREALLOCATE-CAPACITY.actual.json"
            and args.prelaunch_capacity.resolve() == PRELAUNCH/"PRELAUNCH-CAPACITY.actual.json"
            and not args.prelaunch_capacity.exists(), "Exact unused postallocate capacity output")
    import win32api, win32con
    keeper_target = C/"keepers/a66"
    require(not E.exists() and not keeper_target.exists(), "Unused a66 attempt")

    E.mkdir(parents=True)

    env.pop("PYTHONPATH",None)
    held = ORIGINAL_HANDLES
    guards: list[Held] = []
    allocation: dict[str,object] | None = None
    live: Path | None = None
    keeper: Path | None = None

    public: Held | None = None
    finalization_started = False
    cas_attempted = False
    common = ["--runtime",runtime["path"],"--products",products["path"],"--product","religious-ritual-fusion",
              "--case","ui_rejection","--prepared-case",prepared["path"]]
    def start(label: str, argv: list[str], ttl_end: float | None=None) -> Held:
        put(label+".intent",{"argv":argv,"source_commit":args.source_commit,"started_at_utc":now().isoformat()})
        out=(E/(label+".stdout.log")).open("xb")
        err=(E/(label+".stderr.log")).open("xb")
        try:
            if ttl_end is not None:
                require(time.monotonic()<=ttl_end,"Display/probe/public30s TTL expired")
            process=subprocess.Popen(argv,cwd=REPO,env=env,stdout=out,stderr=err)
        except BaseException:
            out.close();err.close()
            raise
        item=Held(label,argv,process,out,err,time.monotonic(),"UNAVAILABLE")
        held.append(item)  # Retain before any identity/receipt operation can fail.
        item.birth_filetime=creation(process)
        put(label+".started",{"pid":process.pid,"process_creation_filetime_100ns":item.birth_filetime,
             "process_create_time_seconds":creation_seconds(item.birth_filetime),
             "started_at_utc":now().isoformat(),"original_wait_pending":True})
        return item

    def wait(item: Held) -> int:
        return consume_original(item)

    def run(label: str, argv: list[str]) -> Held:
        item=start(label,argv)
        require(wait(item)==0,"Original command failed: "+label)
        return item

    def await_json(path: Path, item: Held, seconds: int) -> dict[str,object]:
        end=time.monotonic()+seconds
        while time.monotonic()<end:
            try:
                return read(path)
            except (FileNotFoundError,json.JSONDecodeError):
                require(item.process.poll() is None,"Original child ended before "+str(path))
                time.sleep(.1)
        raise TimeoutError(str(path))

    def normal_facts() -> dict[str,object] | None:
        """Read two actual terminal branches; failure cleanup never grants normal/business credit."""
        if live is None:
            return None
        try:
            close=read(live/"case-output/normal-close-result.json")
            retained=read(live/"case-output/actual-retained-handle-os-exit.json")
            host=read(live/"host-original-process-exit.json")
        except (FileNotFoundError,json.JSONDecodeError):
            return None
        common=(close.get("cleanup_ok") is True and close.get("managed_thread_finished") is True
                and retained.get("actual_retained_os0") is True
                and type(retained.get("exit_code")) is int and retained["exit_code"]==0
                and host.get("actual_original_popen_wait") is True
                and type(host.get("returncode")) is int
                and host.get("run_id")==live.name)
        if not common:
            return None
        if close.get("normal_close_qualified") is True and host["returncode"]==0:
            return {"kind":"normal","normal":close,"retained":retained,"host":host}
        if (close.get("normal_close_qualified") is False and close.get("business_pass") is False
                and close.get("failure_preserved") is True and close.get("failure_lifecycle_completed") is True
                and host["returncode"]==1):
            proof=obj(close.get("failure_shutdown_proof"))
            native=obj(proof.get("process_exit_zero_proof"))
            shutdown=obj(native.get("shutdown"))
            birth=retained.get("creation_filetime_100ns")
            embedded=obj(close.get("retained_handle"))
            if (proof.get("failure_preserved") is True and proof.get("business_pass") is False
                    and proof.get("normal_close_qualified") is False and proof.get("alive_or_business_credit") is False
                    and native.get("managed_session_done") is True
                    and type(native.get("process_exit_code")) is int and native["process_exit_code"]==0
                    and type(retained.get("pid")) is int and native.get("pid")==retained["pid"]
                    and shutdown.get("ck3_pid")==retained["pid"] and shutdown.get("ck3_exit_code")==0
                    and shutdown.get("ok") is True and shutdown.get("cleanup_proven") is True
                    and shutdown.get("tree_gone") is True and shutdown.get("job_active_processes_final")==0
                    and isinstance(birth,str) and re.fullmatch("[1-9][0-9]*",birth) is not None
                    and embedded.get("pid")==retained["pid"] and embedded.get("actual_retained_os0") is True
                    and embedded.get("exit_code")==0 and embedded.get("creation_filetime_100ns")==birth):
                return {"kind":"preserved_failure","normal":close,"retained":retained,"host":host}
        return None

    NORMAL_FACTS_READER=normal_facts

    def hold_for_normal() -> dict[str,object]:
        last=0.0
        while True:
            facts=normal_facts()
            if facts is not None:
                return facts
            if time.monotonic()-last>=60:
                print("ROOT_HOLDS_ORIGINAL_HANDLES_UNTIL_ACTUAL_NORMAL_OR_PRESERVED_FAILURE_CLEANUP",flush=True)
                last=time.monotonic()
            try:
                time.sleep(.25)
            except BaseException:
                # Interrupts do not silently drop original public/allocator handles.
                traceback.print_exc()

    def restore_display() -> None:
        if before is None:
            return
        mode=win32api.EnumDisplaySettings(None,win32con.ENUM_CURRENT_SETTINGS)
        if (mode.PelsWidth,mode.PelsHeight,mode.DisplayFrequency,mode.BitsPerPel)!=(
                before["width"],before["height"],before["frequency"],before["bits"]):
            mode.PelsWidth,mode.PelsHeight=before["width"],before["height"]
            mode.DisplayFrequency,mode.BitsPerPel=before["frequency"],before["bits"]
            require(win32api.ChangeDisplaySettings(mode,0)==0,"Restore original display")
        mode=win32api.EnumDisplaySettings(None,win32con.ENUM_CURRENT_SETTINGS)
        require((mode.PelsWidth,mode.PelsHeight)==(before["width"],before["height"]),"Actual restored display")
        put("DISPLAY-RESTORED",{"before":before,"actual":[mode.PelsWidth,mode.PelsHeight]})

    def stop_keeper(message: str) -> None:
        if keeper is not None and not (keeper/"STOP").exists():
            with (keeper/"STOP").open("x",encoding="utf-8") as stream:
                stream.write(message+"\n")

    def cancel_own_guards() -> None:
        return  # No external cold guard is created for this independent UI hold1800.

    def finalize() -> int:
        nonlocal finalization_started,cas_attempted
        facts=normal_facts()
        require(public is not None and facts is not None,"Actual normal or preserved-failure lifecycle before finalization")
        normal=facts["kind"]=="normal"
        finalization_started=True
        public_code=wait(public)
        for item in guards:
            wait(item)
        verified=start("PUBLIC-VERIFY",PUBLIC+["verify"]+common+["--run-context",str(reviewed)])
        verify_code=wait(verified)
        stop_keeper("Root consumed actual nativeOS0/retainedOS0 and original host terminal; normal="+str(normal)+
                    "; preserved failure/business flags remain actual. Original public/guard waits consumed.")
        allocate_code=wait(allocator)
        require(allocate_code==0 and read(live/"keeper-actual-parent-exit.json")["keeper_actual_exit_code"]==0,
                "Actual original allocator/keeper0")
        restore_display()
        ki=read(keeper/"inputs.json")
        bus=[str(PY),"-B","-X","utf8",str(ki["source_cli"]),"--bus-dir",str(ki["bus_dir"]),
             "--expected-cli-sha256",str(ki["bus_cli_sha256"])]
        run("SCREEN-LIST",bus+["list","--require-existing","--stale-after","600"])
        tasks=read(E/"SCREEN-LIST.stdout.log")["tasks"]
        rows=[row for row in tasks if row["task_id"]==allocation["task"]]
        require(len(rows)==1 and rows[0]["resources"]==["ck3-screen:acquired"],"Actual fresh own SCREEN")
        cas_attempted=True
        run("SCREEN-RELEASE",bus+["release-screen-cas","--task",str(allocation["task"]),
            "--expected-sequence",str(rows[0]["last_sequence"]),"--summary",
            "Actual nativeOS0 retainedOS0 host terminal keeper0 allocator0; normal="+str(normal)+
            "; display restored; original business/failure result retained"])
        put("ALL-ORIGINAL-TERMINALS",{"run_id":live.name,"public_returncode":public_code,
            "verify_returncode":verify_code,"allocator_returncode":allocate_code,
            "screen_release":pin(E/"SCREEN-RELEASE.stdout.log"),"normal_close_qualified":normal,
            "business_pass":normal and public_code==verify_code==0,
            "failure_preserved":facts["kind"]=="preserved_failure",
            "actual_lifecycle_kind":facts["kind"],"actual_host_returncode":obj(facts["host"])["returncode"],
            "lifecycle_facts":facts,
            "original_handles":[{"label":x.label,"pid":x.process.pid,"birth_filetime":x.birth_filetime,
                "actual_original_popen_wait":x.waited,"returncode":x.code,
                "stdout_closed":x.stdout.closed,"stderr_closed":x.stderr.closed} for x in held]})
        print("ACTUAL_CLOSED "+live.name+" "+str(facts["kind"]),flush=True)
        return 0 if normal and public_code==verify_code==0 else 2

    put("STATIC-INPUTS-PRECOMPILED",{"source_commit":args.source_commit,"grant":grant_ref,"ready":ready_ref,
        "original_a63":pin(SOURCE_ORIGINAL),"original_a64":pin(SOURCE_A64),"previous_session_closure":prior_ref,"previous_release":release_ref,
        "preallocate_capacity":pre["receipt"],"postallocate_capacity_path":str(args.prelaunch_capacity),
        "new_capacity_scanner_created":False,"cold_guard_used":False,"original_Popen_registry_retained":True})
    try:
        # The public allocator itself revalidates previous closure under its original writer lock.
        allocator = start("ALLOCATE", PUBLIC+["allocate"]+common+["--attempt","a66","--keeper-output",str(keeper_target),
            "--previous-live",str(PREVIOUS_LIVE),"--previous-keeper",str(PREVIOUS_KEEPER),
            "--previous-release",str(args.previous_release)]+(
            ["--latest-screen-release",str(args.latest_screen_release)] if latest_release is not None else []))
        allocation = await_json(E/"ALLOCATE.stdout.log",allocator,180)
        require(allocation.get("status") == "ACTUAL_ALLOCATED_KEEPER_READY_NOT_RUN"
                and allocation.get("game_started") is False and allocator.process.poll() is None, "Original allocator READY")
        live = Path(str(allocation["live"]));context = live/"ready-context.json";keeper = Path(str(allocation["keeper_root"]))
        require(live.parent == C/"live" and re.fullmatch(MACHINE+"--religious-ritual-fusion--R[0-9]+",live.name) is not None
                and keeper == keeper_target, "Actual allocated C18/a66 identity")
        put("ALLOCATION-CONSUMED",{"actual":allocation,"source":pin(E/"ALLOCATE.stdout.log")})
        put("AWAITING-ROOT-PRELAUNCH-CAPACITY",{"run_id":live.name,"ready_context":pin(context),
            "allocation_stdout":pin(E/"ALLOCATE.stdout.log"),"grant":grant_ref,
            "expected_output":str(args.prelaunch_capacity),"maximum_wait_seconds":180,
            "Game_not_started":True,"capacity_collector_owner":"/root"})
        print("ACTUAL_READY_ROOT_CAPACITY_REQUIRED "+live.name,flush=True)
        gate_deadline = time.monotonic()+180
        while True:
            require(allocator.process.poll() is None, "Original allocator ended before Root capacity")
            if args.prelaunch_capacity.is_file():
                try:
                    cap = capacity_gate(args.prelaunch_capacity,"prelaunch",grant_ref,grant,args.source_commit,6720,
                        context=context,allocation_stdout=E/"ALLOCATE.stdout.log",run_id=live.name)
                    break
                except json.JSONDecodeError:
                    pass
            if time.monotonic() >= gate_deadline:
                raise TimeoutError("Root postallocate capacity not delivered within180s; no public run")
            time.sleep(.1)
        mode = win32api.EnumDisplaySettings(None,win32con.ENUM_CURRENT_SETTINGS)
        before = {"width":mode.PelsWidth,"height":mode.PelsHeight,"frequency":mode.DisplayFrequency,"bits":mode.BitsPerPel}
        mode.PelsWidth,mode.PelsHeight = 2560,1440
        require(win32api.ChangeDisplaySettings(mode,win32con.CDS_TEST) == 0 and win32api.ChangeDisplaySettings(mode,0) == 0,
                "Actual approved display change")
        mode = win32api.EnumDisplaySettings(None,win32con.ENUM_CURRENT_SETTINGS)
        require((mode.PelsWidth,mode.PelsHeight) == (2560,1440), "Actual capture display")
        put("DISPLAY-MODE",{"before":before,"actual":[mode.PelsWidth,mode.PelsHeight]})
        ttl_end = time.monotonic()+30
        offline = E/"STEAM-OFFLINE.prelaunch.actual.json"
        run("STEAM-PROBE",[str(PY),"-B","-X","utf8","tools/steam_offline_state_probe.py","--receipt",str(offline)])
        steam = read(offline);age = (now()-datetime.fromisoformat(str(steam["observed_at_utc"]))).total_seconds()
        require(steam.get("status") == "offline" and steam.get("offline_mode") is True
                and steam.get("machine_id") == MACHINE and 0 <= age <= 30, "Fresh background offline receipt")
        reviewed = live/"reviewed-context-root.json"
        value = read(context);value.update(reviewer="/root",reviewed_at_utc=now().isoformat(),steam_offline_receipt=str(offline))
        with reviewed.open("x",encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            json.dump(value,stream,allow_nan=False)
        require(pin(args.grant) == grant_ref and now() < datetime.fromisoformat(str(obj(cap["gate"])["effective_latest_launch_utc"]).replace("Z","+00:00"))
                and (expiry-now()).total_seconds() >= 6720, "Actual final capacity/launch reserve")
        put("LAUNCH-GATES-CONSUMED",{"capacity":cap["receipt"],"offline":pin(offline),"offline_age_seconds":age,
            "original_ready":pin(keeper/"ready.json"),"generic_UI_case":True,"cold_guard_used":False})
        public = start("PUBLIC-RUN",PUBLIC+["run"]+common+["--run-context",str(reviewed)],ttl_end)
        print("ACTUAL_PUBLIC_RUNNING "+live.name,flush=True)
        hold_for_normal()
        return finalize()
    except BaseException as error:
        # Determine public-start from the retained registry even if started receipt failed.
        actual_public=next((item for item in held if item.label=="PUBLIC-RUN"),None)
        try:
            put("ROOT-SERIAL-FAILURE",{"error":repr(error),"public_started":actual_public is not None,
                "display_before":before,"no_automatic_replay":True,"screen_CAS_attempted":cas_attempted,
                "original_handles":[{"label":x.label,"pid":x.process.pid,"birth_filetime":x.birth_filetime,
                    "original_wait_consumed":x.waited,"actual_returncode":x.code} for x in held]})
        except BaseException:
            traceback.print_exc()
        traceback.print_exc()
        if actual_public is not None:
            public=actual_public
            print("ROOT_RETAINS_PUBLIC_ALLOCATOR_GUARDS_UNTIL_ROOT_ACTUAL_LIFECYCLE",flush=True)
            hold_for_normal()
            if not finalization_started:
                try:
                    return finalize()
                except BaseException:
                    traceback.print_exc()
            # Finalization fault/possibly dispatched CAS: never reissue an unknown operation.
            # Root must finish keeper/resource recovery externally. This process keeps every handle.
            print("ROOT_MANUAL_FINALIZATION_REQUIRED_NO_REPLAY",flush=True)
            for item in held:
                if not item.waited:
                    wait(item)
            return 1
        # No public Popen exists. Only a proven owned, never-Game keeper is stopped.
        if live is None:
            try:
                value=read(E/"ALLOCATE.stdout.log")
                if value.get("status")=="ACTUAL_ALLOCATED_KEEPER_READY_NOT_RUN" and value.get("game_started") is False:
                    live=Path(str(value["live"]));keeper=Path(str(value["keeper_root"]))
            except (FileNotFoundError,json.JSONDecodeError):
                pass
        safe=live is not None and keeper==keeper_target and live.parent==C/"live" and not any(
            (live/name).exists() for name in ("launch-intent.json","launch.json","host-started.json","native-report.json"))
        if safe:
            stop_keeper("Root pre-public failure; original allocation proves own never-Game keeper; no continuation qualification.")
            cancel_own_guards()
            for item in held:
                if not item.waited:
                    wait(item)
            restore_display()
            return 1
        print("ROOT_UNKNOWN_PREPUBLIC_STATE_RETAINS_ORIGINAL_HANDLES_MANUAL_CLOSE_REQUIRED",flush=True)
        # An already-ended allocator can always have its original wait consumed.
        # An ambiguous live allocator is held, not blindly terminated/STOPped.
        for item in held:
            if not item.waited:
                wait(item)
        return 1



if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        result = main()
    finally:
        drain_original_handles()
    raise SystemExit(result)
